title: All clients retry together
stimulus: An internal service becomes slow. Thousands of clients simultaneously retry their timed-out calls. Propose a retry policy with a budget and explain the limits of backoff and jitter when the underlying work is not repeat-safe.
structural_context: Correlated retries and independent overload/idempotency concerns.

hints.content: Identify the precise assertion you need to justify before proposing a solution.
Look for a change in assumptions that would make your proposed reasoning fail.
